description: Fifth Edition (1997): 434 distinct cards and 449 original English printings, every one a reprint of the 1997 pool or of Packs 2 to 4.
name: Fifth Edition
rules_note: Fifth Edition adds no new rules identity: every card already has a script in the game or in Packs 2 to 4. The pack contributes its 449 printings with artwork, four illustrations for each basic land, and a Fifth Edition source for the 147 Ice Age, Homelands and Fallen Empires cards it reprints.
